review_notes: I read the whole file. The only new definition is the private `qContract`, which sends `f` to the series with coefficients `f.coeff (ℓ*m)`. It is a left inverse of the project's own `qExpand` on series supported on multiples of ℓ. I searched Mathlib's HahnSeries files for a matching concept (`comapDomain`, `embDomain`, `ofSuppBddBelow`) and found nothing. `embDomain` is the forward direction only and needs an order embedding, so it does not give a contraction. The project does have a near-duplicate, `qDecimate` in Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_XHDifferentialsModL.lean. It is a project-internal duplicate, not a Mathlib one, and that file is not imported here, so it falls outside this rubric. The other declarations are theorems or lemmas. They are excluded as standalone theorem duplication or proof shortening, and I found no competing structure or class. `coeffMap` and `coeffEmb` come from Definitions files and are not defined in this file. `coeffMap_qTwist` is a lemma about them. I found no Mathlib-duplicating definition in this file that I can justify consolidating.
